name: en-gb-academic
about: British English academic prose (essays, reports) without formulas: typical errors of student writing, American spellings that are errors in en-GB, and correct British sentences that checkers tuned to American English flag (collective nouns with plural verbs, -ise, whilst, learnt, programme/program, licence/practise). The same form as math-en.json (#75): errors[].wrong is the wrong text (its first occurrence), kind is grammar / spelling / punctuation, ok lists fragments of which the text must contain one once the suggested fix is put in; errors: [] means a correct text, where every finding is a false alarm. source: made = written for this set.
